rows.question: 8月苹果、华为与小米的净实付成交额对比
rows.gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '已取消' THEN NULL ELSE o.pay_amount END) FROM products p INNER JOIN orders o ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand IN ('苹果','华为','小米') AND o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.brand
rows.reason: 三个品牌的完整净额结果必须全部匹配，不能只检查首个品牌名。
rows.sql:
SELECT p.brand AS value, SUM(o.pay_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.status <> '已取消') AS metric
FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01'
  AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01'
  AND p.brand IN ('苹果', '华为', '小米')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

rows.reason: 金额歧义先澄清；本样本明确选择净实付，保留渠道。

FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01'
  AND o.order_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01'
  AND o.channel = '小程序'
